UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIRNAAC AcCREDITED GRADE A++
UNIVERSITY CAMPUS, HAZRATBAL, SRINAGAR 190006, KASHMIR.
NOTICE
The link for submission of online application forms along withprescribed fee for the post(s) of Assistant Professor advertised vide
Advertisment notice No. 17 of 2026 dated 06-08-2026 has been
extended upto 7:00 p.m today. All the concerned/ interested
candidates may note accordingly.
No further extension in this regard will be granted.
By order,
No.F (Extension / Assistant Professor) Rect/26
Dated: 09/09/2026

(Recruitment)
